assignments.scope: Plan and run LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns aimed at US finance managers at small businesses, live on launch day 2 Dec 2026, within the $90,000 paid media budget. Deliver a media plan with budget split by platform for client approval, audiences (LinkedIn targeting on company size 20 to 200 for demo goal), keyword plan for Search, and campaigns built in draft with Data's naming convention and tracking links by 25 Nov (MED-1). Go live 2 Dec and pace budget daily for the first two weeks, optimising to sign-ups and demo requests. Note: these platforms sit outside the usual app UA remit, and Black Friday week is busy, so build drafts early. Team is free from 2 Nov. Any time-saved claim in ad copy must come from the legal-approved claims sheet (PR-1).

Own core launch messaging and the time-saved claims sheet, and get it approved by client legal by 2 Nov (PR-1) so every team uses the same approved claims. Write the launch press release with spokesperson quote, final and legal-approved by 16 Nov (PR-2). Build a target list of small-business and fintech trade press, pitch under embargo, run briefings between 16 Nov and 23 Nov, prep the spokesperson, and distribute the release on launch day 2 Dec with the embargo lifting that day. Invite press to the launch webinar. Track coverage after launch.

Produce three LinkedIn ad concepts and the product demo video concept, approved by the client by 9 Nov (CRE-1). Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form, SEO input from Organic and Data's tracking, with copy legal-approved and page live by 16 Nov (CRE-2) so registration can open. The page is web, not app, so ignore store badge criteria; it must pass mobile QA. Produce final LinkedIn ad creative in all LinkedIn formats and the demo video, legal-reviewed and delivered to Media by 23 Nov (CRE-3). Each video edit round needs 3 working days and capacity is about 80% until 6 Nov, so plan edit rounds early. Supply a cut of the demo video for the webinar and press.

Provide SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page by 26 Oct (ORG-1). Write two SEO articles on expense automation: keyword briefs by 11 Nov, drafts to client and legal so approval lands at least 5 working days before publishing, publish on or just after launch and link from the landing page. Write the webinar registration email sequence (invite, reminders, day-of, follow-up with recording and demo request CTA), using legal-approved claims only, starting once the landing page is live on 16 Nov. Who sends the emails and on which platform is still open with the client; plan copy and schedule either way. Use Data's UTM convention on every link.

This is a web and CRM funnel, not an app, so adapt the measurement playbook: no MMP or SKAN. Agree the tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields (company size, source, campaign) by 9 Nov (DAT-1). Implement tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click through landing page and webinar registration to sign-up and demo request in the client CRM, live and QA'd by 23 Nov (DAT-2). QA Media's draft tracking links from 25 Nov (MED-1) before go-live. Dashboard live on launch day 2 Dec tracking sign-ups (target 2,500 in 45 days), demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies (target 400), spend and cost per lead. Weekly pipeline report every Monday from 7 Dec and a wrap report after day 45 (16 Jan 2027).

tasks.title: Deliver LinkedIn and Google Search media plan with budget split by platform for client approval
acceptance_criteria: Plan splits the $90,000 paid media budget by platform (LinkedIn, Google Search) with a pacing curve for the full 45-day flight, 2 Dec to 15 Jan
Reduced caps set for the 25 Dec, 28 Dec and 1 Jan closed days and the holiday weeks
Targets and forecasts tied to 2,500 sign-ups in 45 days and 400 demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies
Client approval of plan and budget split recorded in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed the full $90,000 is paid media for LinkedIn and Google Search, US only, and Media is approved to run these lead-gen platforms (orchestrator Q1 and Q4). If budget covers other costs or the split is set by the client, the plan changes.

tasks.title: Define LinkedIn audiences and Google Search keyword plan for US small-business finance managers
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn audiences target US finance job functions and titles at companies of 20 to 200 staff for the demo goal, with a separate sign-up audience
Search keyword plan grouped into brand, category (expense and receipt automation) and competitor ad groups with negatives and bids
Keyword list shared with Organic for alignment with SEO terms

tasks.title: Write Google Search ads and, with Creative, LinkedIn ad text from the approved claims sheet and get legal sign-off
acceptance_criteria: Every time-saved claim is quoted from the PR-1 legal-approved claims sheet, no new claims
LinkedIn intro text written with Creative from the CRE-1 approved concepts, and responsive search ads drafted per ad group, US English
Ad text submitted to client legal by 11 Nov
Client legal approval received by 20 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed client legal can review Media's ad text in about 5 working days after a 11 Nov submission (orchestrator Q3). A slower turnaround would push approval past the 23 Nov cut-off for 2 Dec use.

tasks.title: Build LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns in draft with Data naming convention and tracking links for QA
acceptance_criteria: All LinkedIn and Search campaigns built in draft, named per the DAT-1 convention, with audiences, keywords, bids and budgets from the approved plan
Final CRE-3 LinkedIn creative and demo video plus approved ad text loaded, landing URLs point to the CRE-2 webinar page
Every ad has UTM tracking links per DAT-1 and the draft list is shared with Data for QA before Black Friday week
tasks.assumption: Search drafts and LinkedIn shells are built from 16 Nov so only creative upload remains after CRE-3 on 23 Nov, given Black Friday week load.

tasks.title: Complete pre-launch QA with Data and confirm launch readiness
acceptance_criteria: Test clicks from each campaign arrive in the CRM with correct UTMs as per DAT-2 and DAT-8
LinkedIn Insight Tag and Google Ads conversions for registration, sign-up and demo request firing
All ads approved by the platforms, with 1 Dec changes limited to tracking parameters, and scheduled to start 2 Dec
Go-live confirmed in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed platform ad review completes within 1 to 2 working days of submission.

tasks.title: Launch LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns on launch day
acceptance_criteria: All campaigns live by 9:00 ET on 2 Dec, ahead of the afternoon webinar
First-hours spend, delivery and conversion tracking checked and reported in #launch-ledgerly by 13:00 ET

tasks.title: Pace budget daily and optimise to sign-ups and demo requests for the first two weeks
acceptance_criteria: Daily spend kept within 10% of planned pacing, logged in a daily pacing sheet
Bids, keywords and audiences shifted toward lowest cost per sign-up and per demo request from 20 to 200 staff companies
Two-week summary of spend, sign-ups and demo requests shared with Data for the weekly pipeline report
tasks.assumption: Assumed Media keeps managing spend after the two-week window through the 45-day goal period at lower intensity.

tasks.title: Write core launch messaging and time-saved claims sheet and get client legal approval
acceptance_criteria: Draft messaging house and claims sheet submitted to client legal by 26 Oct, with source evidence for each time-saved claim
Every time-saved claim marked approved, amended or cut by client legal in writing
Approved version shared in #launch-ledgerly as the single source for Creative, Organic and Media
US English spelling throughout
tasks.assumption: Client legal can turn the review around within 5 working days (26 Oct to 2 Nov), raised as Q3. A longer turnaround would push every team that uses the claims.

tasks.title: Build and get client approval for the US small-business and fintech trade press target list
acceptance_criteria: List covers US small-business and fintech trade titles with named journalist, beat and contact for each
Each outlet tiered by priority with a note on embargo practice
Target list approved by the client in writing

tasks.title: Draft launch press release with spokesperson quote and submit to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Release uses only time-saved claims from the approved PR-1 claims sheet
Spokesperson quote drafted and approved by the spokesperson
Client marketing review done and release submitted to client legal by 9 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed the client names a spokesperson (likely CEO or Head of Product) by 2 Nov. If not, the quote and the briefings slip.

tasks.title: Finalize press release with client legal approval, ready for embargoed briefings
acceptance_criteria: Final release approved by the client and by client legal in writing
Spokesperson quote approved
Embargo lift time agreed with the client as 2 Dec at 9:00 ET and marked on the embargoed version
Final shared with Organic in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Client legal reviews the release within 5 working days of the 9 Nov submission. A longer review would compress the briefing window.

tasks.title: Pitch target press under embargo and book briefings for 16 to 23 Nov
acceptance_criteria: Embargoed pitch sent to every tier 1 and tier 2 contact on the approved list
Embargo terms (lift on 2 Dec) accepted in writing by each journalist before briefing
Briefings booked in the 16 to 23 Nov window, before it opens

tasks.title: Prepare the spokesperson for embargoed briefings
acceptance_criteria: Briefing pack delivered: key messages, approved claims only, Q&A on tricky questions, journalist bios
At least one mock briefing run with the spokesperson
Spokesperson confirms availability for all booked slots
tasks.assumption: Assumed a spokesperson is named by 2 Nov and available 16 to 23 Nov. If not named, prep and briefings move.

tasks.title: Run embargoed briefings and invite press to the 2 Dec launch webinar
acceptance_criteria: All booked briefings held between 16 and 23 Nov and logged with notes and follow-ups
Embargoed release and approved product stills sent to each briefed journalist, with the demo video offered for 2 Dec
Press invited to the launch webinar using the live registration page, with RSVPs tracked
tasks.assumption: Assumed the webinar time is confirmed and registration opens 16 Nov (Q5). If registration opens later, press invites follow it.

tasks.title: Distribute the press release on launch day as the embargo lifts
acceptance_criteria: Release distributed on 2 Dec at 9:00 ET, the lift time set in PR-2, to the approved list
Release live on the client newsroom with the webinar link and the CRE-9 press cut
Briefed journalists reminded that the embargo has lifted
tasks.assumption: Assumed a distribution method is agreed (direct to list or a wire service). A wire service needs budget, raised in Q4.

tasks.title: Track launch coverage and report results
acceptance_criteria: Coverage log of every piece with outlet, date, reach and claims accuracy
Any misquoted time-saved claim flagged to the client within 1 working day
Coverage report shared with the client and in #launch-ledgerly by 9 Dec

tasks.title: Develop and present three LinkedIn ad concepts and the demo video script and storyboard to Ledgerly
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct LinkedIn ad concepts aimed at US finance managers at companies with 20 to 200 staff, each shown as single image, carousel and video ad mockups
Demo video script and storyboard show receipt scanning filing expenses automatically, with product screen capture recorded so editing can start right after approval
Every time-saved claim used is taken word for word from the PR-1 legal-approved claims sheet
Concepts presented to the client and shared in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Team is at about 80% until 6 Nov, so concept work starts on kickoff with placeholder claims that are swapped for PR-1 wording on 2 to 4 Nov. If PR-1 slips, the presentation and CRE-1 slip with it.

tasks.title: Get client approval of the LinkedIn ad and demo video concepts
acceptance_criteria: Written client approval of three LinkedIn ad concepts and the demo video concept is recorded
One round of client feedback is folded in before approval
Approved concepts handed to Media with planned formats listed

tasks.title: Write webinar landing page wireframe and copy with SEO keywords and send copy to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Wireframe covers hero, webinar details for 2 Dec, demo video slot and registration form
Copy uses the primary and secondary keywords from ORG-1 in title, H1 and meta description
Time-saved claims match the PR-1 sheet and copy is sent to client legal by 3 Nov so approval lands by 9 Nov, 5 working days before the page goes live
US English spelling throughout

tasks.title: Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form and tracking, and pass mobile QA
acceptance_criteria: Page built with the legal-approved copy only, with client legal sign-off on file dated no later than 9 Nov
Registration form fields, UTM capture and tracking tags match the DAT-1 tracking plan and CRM lead fields, and a test submission reaches the webinar platform
Page passes mobile QA on iOS Safari and Android Chrome, plus desktop browsers (web page, no store badges)
Client approves the staging page

tasks.title: Publish the webinar landing page live with registration open
acceptance_criteria: Page is live on the production URL and a live test registration is received
Live copy matches the legal-approved version
URL shared with Organic, Data and Media in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Registration opens on 16 Nov, pending the human answer to Q5 on webinar time and early registration. If the time changes, only the webinar details block needs updating.

tasks.title: Cut the demo video rough cut and complete edit round 1
acceptance_criteria: Rough cut shared with the client on 10 Nov, built from the approved script and screen capture
Edit round 1 runs 11 to 13 Nov (3 working days) with client feedback logged
On-screen claims match the PR-1 sheet
tasks.assumption: Demo video is screen-recorded with motion graphics made in house, not a live-action shoot, so a rough cut can be ready one day after approval. A shoot would push CRE-3 past 23 Nov.

tasks.title: Complete demo video edit round 2, produce LinkedIn ads in all formats and send both to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Static and carousel ads for all three concepts sent to client legal on 13 Nov, ahead of the video package
Edit round 2 runs 16 to 18 Nov (3 working days) and the video is picture-locked with captions, then sent to client legal with the video ads on 18 Nov
Ads produced at 1200x1200 and 1200x628 for single image and carousel, 1:1 and 16:9 for video, with document ad as PDF
File names follow the DAT-1 naming convention

tasks.title: Deliver final legal-approved LinkedIn ad creative and demo video to Media
acceptance_criteria: Written client legal approval of every asset received by 23 Nov, 5 working days before the 2 Dec launch
Legal fixes made and files meet LinkedIn specs for size, length and file type
Assets handed to Media and Organic in a shared folder linked in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Client legal reviews assets within 2 working days (19 to 20 Nov), with fixes on 23 Nov. Q3 asks legal to confirm turnaround. A longer review would put the 23 Nov handoff at risk.

tasks.title: Deliver the demo video webinar cut and the press cut for launch day distribution
acceptance_criteria: Webinar cut in 16:9 delivered to the webinar owner by 24 Nov
Press cut with download link sent to PR by 24 Nov for the 2 Dec release, not for the embargoed briefings
Both cuts use only the legal-approved edit and claims
tasks.assumption: Webinar and press cuts are re-edits of the approved master, so they need no new legal review.

tasks.title: Deliver SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page copy to Creative
acceptance_criteria: Primary and secondary keywords for receipt scanning and expense automation listed with US search volume
Recommended page title, meta description, H1 and URL slug supplied
Shared with Creative in #launch-ledgerly by 26 Oct

tasks.title: Write keyword briefs for two SEO articles on expense automation
acceptance_criteria: Each article has one agreed target keyword, US market, US spelling
Briefs include outline, search intent, internal link to the webinar landing page and demo request CTA
Target keywords agreed with the client by 11 Nov

tasks.title: Draft both SEO articles and submit to client and legal review
acceptance_criteria: Two drafts written to their keyword briefs in US English
Time-saved claims used only as worded in the PR-1 approved claims sheet
All links tagged with Data's UTM convention from DAT-1
Drafts sent to client and legal by 16 Nov, 5 working days before the approval deadline

tasks.title: Secure client and legal approval of both SEO articles
acceptance_criteria: Written legal approval for both articles received by 23 Nov, 5 working days before the 2 Dec publish (Thanksgiving closures counted)
Feedback rounds applied and final versions logged
tasks.assumption: Assumed client legal can review in about 5 working days, which Q3 is confirming. A slower turnaround pushes publishing after launch.

tasks.title: Publish both SEO articles and link them from the webinar landing page
acceptance_criteria: Both approved articles live on launch day, each targeting its agreed keyword
Both articles linked from the webinar landing page and linking back to it
Every link carries the DAT-1 UTM tags and is checked in Data's QA

tasks.title: Write webinar email sequence copy and send schedule and submit to client and client legal
acceptance_criteria: Copy for invite, two reminders, day-of email and follow-up with recording and demo request CTA, in US English
Only time-saved claims from the PR-1 approved claims sheet, used verbatim
Sent to client and client legal by 3 Nov, with legal approval due by 9 Nov, 5 working days before the 16 Nov invite

tasks.title: Hand over approved invite and reminder emails for send from 16 Nov
acceptance_criteria: Client legal approval of the email copy on file, dated no later than 9 Nov
Invite links to the live CRE-2 registration page and every link carries DAT-1 UTMs
Approved copy and schedule handed to the confirmed sender on the confirmed platform
Test send checked for links, UTMs and rendering before the invite goes out
tasks.assumption: Assumed the client confirms sender and platform (Q2) before 16 Nov. If Organic must build in a client ESP or the webinar tool, setup time is needed and the invite may slip.

tasks.title: Send the follow-up email with webinar recording and demo request CTA on 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Follow-up sent on 3 Dec with the ORG-10 recording link
Demo request CTA points to the CRE-10 page and carries DAT-1 UTMs
Demo video from CRE-3 used only in its legal-approved form
tasks.assumption: Assumed sender (Q2) is confirmed and the recording is exported on 2 Dec in ORG-10.

tasks.title: Agree web and CRM tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields with client
acceptance_criteria: Tracking plan covers ad click, landing page view, webinar registration, sign-up and demo request, with no MMP or SKAN events, and is signed off by the client
UTM and campaign naming convention for LinkedIn and Google Search documented and shared with Media, Creative and Organic in #launch-ledgerly
CRM lead fields for company size (with a 20 to 200 staff band), source and campaign agreed with the client CRM owner
Draft circulated to the client by 29 Oct to leave review time before 9 Nov
tasks.assumption: Measurement playbook adapted for a web and CRM funnel: client product sign-off replaced by client marketing ops and CRM owner sign-off. If the client has no CRM owner available before 9 Nov, the date is at risk.

tasks.title: Configure CRM lead fields, UTM capture and lead source mapping in the client CRM
acceptance_criteria: Company size, source and campaign fields exist in the client CRM and match the DAT-1 spec
Hidden UTM fields spec for the registration, sign-up and demo request forms handed to Creative before the landing page goes live
Test lead created in the CRM sandbox shows all fields populated
tasks.assumption: Data gets admin or field-creation access to the client CRM by 9 Nov. If the client keeps CRM admin in-house, this becomes a spec handover and the client builds the fields.

tasks.title: Implement and QA tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click to CRM demo request
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads conversion tags and web analytics events fire on the live webinar landing page for registration
Test clicks with tagged UTMs from LinkedIn and Google create CRM leads with source, campaign and company size filled
QA log of test journeys shared in #launch-ledgerly, with all defects closed
Sign-up and demo request events on the post-webinar page are covered by DAT-8
tasks.assumption: CRE-2 lands on 16 Nov, leaving 5 working days for tagging and QA. A late landing page compresses QA directly.

tasks.title: QA Media's draft LinkedIn and Google Search tracking links before go-live
acceptance_criteria: Every draft ad's final URL and UTMs match the DAT-1 naming convention
One test click per campaign lands a correctly attributed lead in the CRM
Fix list sent to Media by 30 Nov, limited to tracking templates and UTM parameters so no ad re-enters platform review

tasks.title: Launch the live funnel dashboard on launch day
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows sign-ups against 2,500 in 45 days and demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies against 400
Spend and cost per lead shown by channel (LinkedIn, Google Search) and campaign, against the $90,000 paid media budget
Data refreshes at least daily and access is shared with the client and the team in #launch-ledgerly

tasks.title: Deliver the weekly pipeline report every Monday from 7 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Reports issued 7 Dec, 14 Dec, 21 Dec, 29 Dec (Tue, as 28 Dec is closed), 4 Jan, 11 Jan and 18 Jan
Each report covers sign-ups, demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies, spend and cost per lead against pace to target
Each report lists pipeline from CRM demo requests and one recommended action for Media

tasks.title: Deliver the campaign wrap report after day 45
acceptance_criteria: Measures every brief KPI: 2,500 sign-ups in 45 days and 400 demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies, from 2 Dec 2026 (day 1) to 15 Jan 2027 (day 45)
Reports spend and cost per lead by channel against the $90,000 budget
Includes learnings and recommendations, shared with the client

tasks.title: Build the post-webinar sign-up and demo request landing page for paid traffic from 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Page has a business sign-up form and a demo request form with a company size field matching the DAT-3 CRM spec
Copy reuses only legal-approved wording from CRE-2 and the PR-1 claims sheet, with legal sign-off on file by 24 Nov, 5 working days before 3 Dec use
Page is live on a production URL by 24 Nov so Media can submit ads to it for platform review
Page passes mobile QA on iOS Safari and Android Chrome and desktop browsers
tasks.assumption: Assumed Creative builds a new evergreen page because the webinar page stops serving the paid flight after 2 Dec (F1). If Ledgerly already has sign-up and demo request pages it owns, this becomes a URL and tracking handover and the question on destinations decides it.

tasks.title: Tag and QA sign-up and demo request events on the post-webinar landing page
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads conversions and web analytics fire for sign-up and demo request on the CRE-10 page
Test sign-up and test demo request with tagged UTMs create CRM leads with source, campaign and company size filled
QA log shared in #launch-ledgerly with all defects closed by 30 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed CRE-10 is live by 24 Nov. If the client owns the destination pages, Data QAs their forms instead.

tasks.title: Submit all launch ads and paused post-webinar ad variants for platform review
acceptance_criteria: Every LinkedIn and Google Search ad, pointing at the CRE-2 webinar page, submitted for platform review by 25 Nov
Duplicate ads pointing at the CRE-10 page submitted at the same time and left paused for the 3 Dec switch
Review status logged in #launch-ledgerly, with any rejection fixed and resubmitted by 30 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed later fixes are limited to tracking templates and UTM parameters, which do not restart platform review.

tasks.title: Switch paid traffic to the pre-approved post-webinar ads on 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Webinar-page ads paused and CRE-10 page ads switched on by 9:00 ET on 3 Dec
Test click per campaign lands on the CRE-10 page with correct UTMs
Switch confirmed in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed the post-webinar destination is the CRE-10 page and that ads with a replay offer are not wanted. The destination question decides this.

tasks.title: Pace the $90,000 and optimise from 17 Dec to day 45 on 15 Jan, covering closed days
acceptance_criteria: Daily caps and automated rules set before 24 Dec for 25 Dec, 28 Dec and 1 Jan, with a named on-call checker for each closed day
Cumulative spend stays within 5% of plan and total does not exceed $90,000 by 15 Jan
Weekly optimisation notes shared with Data for the pipeline report

tasks.title: Set up the 2 Dec webinar on the licensed platform with presenters, deck and run of show
acceptance_criteria: Webinar event created on the licensed platform with registration integration ready for the CRE-6 test by 12 Nov
Presenters named, deck outline using only PR-1 claims, and run of show agreed with the client
Recording enabled and a rehearsal date set before 2 Dec
tasks.assumption: No team's remit covers webinar production, so Organic is the provisional owner pending the webinar owner question. If the client runs the webinar, this becomes a handover task.

tasks.title: Run the 2 Dec launch webinar and export the recording
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal held by 1 Dec and webinar runs on the afternoon of 2 Dec with the CRE-9 webinar cut
Attendance and registration numbers shared with Data
Recording exported and link ready for the ORG-8 follow-up email the same day
tasks.assumption: Provisional Organic ownership, as for ORG-9. Client presenters are assumed.

tasks.title: Load and schedule the day-of webinar email for 2 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Day-of email built with confirmed webinar time and join link, legal-approved copy only
Test send checked for links, UTMs and rendering by 1 Dec
Send scheduled for the morning of 2 Dec to all registrants
tasks.assumption: Assumed sender and platform are confirmed (Q2) and the webinar time is set (Q5).

flags.question: Media's remit covers app UA (Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, Google App). Is Media staffed and approved to run LinkedIn and Google Search lead-gen campaigns for Ledgerly, or do we need extra support?
flags.why: L15 requires LinkedIn and Google Search live on 2 Dec. MED-1 drafts are due 25 Nov during busy Black Friday week.

flags.question: Who builds and sends the webinar registration email sequence, and on which platform (client ESP, CRM, or webinar tool)? No team's remit covers email sending.
flags.why: Organic is writing the sequence (L18), but sends must begin soon after the landing page goes live on 16 Nov, and Data needs to know the platform for tracking.

flags.question: Can client legal approve the messaging and time-saved claims sheet by 2 Nov, and confirm their turnaround time for reviewing assets after that?
flags.why: L22 requires a 5 working day lead. The landing page (16 Nov), press release (16 Nov) and final ads (23 Nov) all depend on PR-1 being approved by 2 Nov.

flags.question: Is the $90,000 for paid media only, and is there a separate budget for creative production (demo video) and press distribution? How should the $90,000 be split between LinkedIn and Google Search?
flags.why: L23 sets a budget for paid media only. The demo video and wire distribution costs, and the Media plan, depend on the answer.

flags.question: Please confirm the exact webinar time on 2 Dec and approve opening registration from 16 Nov, which is earlier than our standard landing page timing.
flags.why: L11 says only "that afternoon". The landing page, email sequence, press invites and campaign timing all depend on the time and when registration opens.

flags.question: Will Ledgerly provide LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads accounts with agency admin access and billing in place by 16 Nov, or should the agency create and bill these accounts?
flags.why: Media starts building draft campaigns from 16 Nov to hit MED-1 before Black Friday week. Without account access, billing and the LinkedIn Insight Tag, the drafts, tracking QA and 2 Dec go-live slip.

flags.question: Who is Ledgerly's spokesperson for the launch press release quote and the embargoed briefings, and can they be confirmed by 2 Nov and be free 16 to 23 Nov?
flags.why: The release quote (PR-4, legal by 9 Nov), spokesperson prep (PR-6) and the briefings (PR-7) all need a named, available spokesperson. A late name puts the 16 Nov legal-approved release (PR-2) at risk.

flags.question: Can the demo video be a screen-recorded product demo with in-house motion graphics, or does Ledgerly expect a live-action shoot?
flags.why: The plan assumes screen recording, so a rough cut is ready on 10 Nov and two 3-day edit rounds fit before the 23 Nov handoff (CRE-3). A live-action shoot needs booking and extra days and would miss 23 Nov.

flags.question: Which CRM does Ledgerly use, and will the client give Data admin access to create lead fields and test leads by 9 Nov? Also, should company size come from a form field or from enrichment?
flags.why: DAT-3 and DAT-2 need CRM access to build company size, source and campaign fields and to QA ad click to demo request tracking by 23 Nov. The 400 demo request KPI for 20 to 200 staff companies depends on how company size is captured.

flags.question: After the webinar ends on 2 Dec, where should paid ads send traffic for the rest of the 45 days, and who owns the sign-up and demo request pages: Ledgerly or our Creative team (CRE-10)?
flags.why: F1. The ads, tracking and follow-up email need a sign-up and demo request page from 3 Dec. CRE-10, DAT-8, MED-8 and MED-9 assume Creative builds a new page by 24 Nov.

*Ledgerly receipts launch, kickoff*
We launch on *Wed 2 Dec 2026* in the US. Kickoff is today, 19 Oct.

*Critical dates*
• *PR:* claims sheet legal-approved 2 Nov, release final 16 Nov, embargoed briefings 16 to 23 Nov, distribution 2 Dec
• *Creative:* concepts approved 9 Nov, landing page live 16 Nov, final ads and video to Media 23 Nov
• *Media:* media plan 5 Nov, ad copy legal sign-off 20 Nov, draft builds 24 Nov, QA done 1 Dec, launch 2 Dec

*Open questions*

input.question: Who produces and runs the 2 Dec webinar (platform setup, presenters, deck, run of show, recording): Ledgerly or the agency? If it is the agency, is Organic the right owner?
input.why: F2. No team's remit covers webinar production. ORG-9 and ORG-10 give it to Organic for now, and the follow-up email (ORG-8) and the CRE-6 registration test depend on it.

name: flag_for_human
text:
Flagged Q11 for the human approver. Do not wait for an answer; keep planning.
[step 7 of 14]

milestones.title: SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page copy
Core launch messaging and time-saved claims sheet approved by client legal
Tracking plan, UTM and naming convention, CRM lead fields agreed
LinkedIn ad and demo video concepts approved by client
Webinar landing page live with registration form, legal-approved copy
Press release final and approved by client legal, ready for embargoed briefings
Final legal-approved LinkedIn ad creative and demo video delivered to Media
Ad click to CRM demo request tracking live and QA'd
LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns built in draft with tracking links for QA

assignments.scope: Plan and run LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns aimed at US finance managers at small businesses, live on launch day 2 Dec 2026, within the $90,000 paid media budget. Deliver a media plan with budget split by platform for client approval, audiences (LinkedIn targeting on company size 20 to 200 for demo goal), keyword plan for Search, and campaigns built in draft with Data's naming convention and tracking links by 25 Nov (MED-1). Go live 2 Dec and pace budget daily for the first two weeks, optimising to sign-ups and demo requests. Note: these platforms sit outside the usual app UA remit, and Black Friday week is busy, so build drafts early. Team is free from 2 Nov. Any time-saved claim in ad copy must come from the legal-approved claims sheet (PR-1).

Own core launch messaging and the time-saved claims sheet, and get it approved by client legal by 2 Nov (PR-1) so every team uses the same approved claims. Write the launch press release with spokesperson quote, final and legal-approved by 16 Nov (PR-2). Build a target list of small-business and fintech trade press, pitch under embargo, run briefings between 16 Nov and 23 Nov, prep the spokesperson, and distribute the release on launch day 2 Dec with the embargo lifting that day. Invite press to the launch webinar. Track coverage after launch.

Produce three LinkedIn ad concepts and the product demo video concept, approved by the client by 9 Nov (CRE-1). Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form, SEO input from Organic and Data's tracking, with copy legal-approved and page live by 16 Nov (CRE-2) so registration can open. The page is web, not app, so ignore store badge criteria; it must pass mobile QA. Produce final LinkedIn ad creative in all LinkedIn formats and the demo video, legal-reviewed and delivered to Media by 23 Nov (CRE-3). Each video edit round needs 3 working days and capacity is about 80% until 6 Nov, so plan edit rounds early. Supply a cut of the demo video for the webinar and press.

Provide SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page by 26 Oct (ORG-1). Write two SEO articles on expense automation: keyword briefs by 11 Nov, drafts to client and legal so approval lands at least 5 working days before publishing, publish on or just after launch and link from the landing page. Write the webinar registration email sequence (invite, reminders, day-of, follow-up with recording and demo request CTA), using legal-approved claims only, starting once the landing page is live on 16 Nov. Who sends the emails and on which platform is still open with the client; plan copy and schedule either way. Use Data's UTM convention on every link.

This is a web and CRM funnel, not an app, so adapt the measurement playbook: no MMP or SKAN. Agree the tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields (company size, source, campaign) by 9 Nov (DAT-1). Implement tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click through landing page and webinar registration to sign-up and demo request in the client CRM, live and QA'd by 23 Nov (DAT-2). QA Media's draft tracking links from 25 Nov (MED-1) before go-live. Dashboard live on launch day 2 Dec tracking sign-ups (target 2,500 in 45 days), demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies (target 400), spend and cost per lead. Weekly pipeline report every Monday from 7 Dec and a wrap report after day 45 (16 Jan 2027).

tasks.title: Deliver LinkedIn and Google Search media plan with budget split by platform for client approval
acceptance_criteria: Plan splits the $90,000 paid media budget by platform (LinkedIn, Google Search) with a pacing curve for the full 45-day flight, 2 Dec to 15 Jan
Reduced caps set for the 25 Dec, 28 Dec and 1 Jan closed days and the holiday weeks
Targets and forecasts tied to 2,500 sign-ups in 45 days and 400 demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies
Client approval of plan and budget split recorded in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed the full $90,000 is paid media for LinkedIn and Google Search, US only, and Media is approved to run these lead-gen platforms (orchestrator Q1 and Q4). If budget covers other costs or the split is set by the client, the plan changes.

tasks.title: Define LinkedIn audiences and Google Search keyword plan for US small-business finance managers
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn audiences target US finance job functions and titles at companies of 20 to 200 staff for the demo goal, with a separate sign-up audience
Search keyword plan grouped into brand, category (expense and receipt automation) and competitor ad groups with negatives and bids
Keyword list shared with Organic for alignment with SEO terms

tasks.title: Write Google Search ads and, with Creative, LinkedIn ad text from the approved claims sheet and get legal sign-off
acceptance_criteria: Every time-saved claim is quoted from the PR-1 legal-approved claims sheet, no new claims
LinkedIn intro text written with Creative from the CRE-1 approved concepts, and responsive search ads drafted per ad group, US English
Ad text submitted to client legal by 11 Nov
Client legal approval received by 20 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed client legal can review Media's ad text in about 5 working days after a 11 Nov submission (orchestrator Q3). A slower turnaround would push approval past the 23 Nov cut-off for 2 Dec use.

tasks.title: Build LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns in draft with Data naming convention and tracking links for QA
acceptance_criteria: All LinkedIn and Search campaigns built in draft, named per the DAT-1 convention, with audiences, keywords, bids and budgets from the approved plan
Final CRE-3 LinkedIn creative and demo video plus approved ad text loaded, landing URLs point to the CRE-2 webinar page
Every ad has UTM tracking links per DAT-1 and the draft list is shared with Data for QA before Black Friday week
tasks.assumption: Search drafts and LinkedIn shells are built from 16 Nov so only creative upload remains after CRE-3 on 23 Nov, given Black Friday week load.

tasks.title: Complete pre-launch QA with Data and confirm launch readiness
acceptance_criteria: Test clicks from each campaign arrive in the CRM with correct UTMs as per DAT-2 and DAT-8
LinkedIn Insight Tag and Google Ads conversions for registration, sign-up and demo request firing
All ads approved by the platforms, with 1 Dec changes limited to tracking parameters, and scheduled to start 2 Dec
Go-live confirmed in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed platform ad review completes within 1 to 2 working days of submission.

tasks.title: Launch LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns on launch day
acceptance_criteria: All campaigns live by 9:00 ET on 2 Dec, ahead of the afternoon webinar
First-hours spend, delivery and conversion tracking checked and reported in #launch-ledgerly by 13:00 ET

tasks.title: Pace budget daily and optimise to sign-ups and demo requests for the first two weeks
acceptance_criteria: Daily spend kept within 10% of planned pacing, logged in a daily pacing sheet
Bids, keywords and audiences shifted toward lowest cost per sign-up and per demo request from 20 to 200 staff companies
Two-week summary of spend, sign-ups and demo requests shared with Data for the weekly pipeline report
tasks.assumption: Assumed Media keeps managing spend after the two-week window through the 45-day goal period at lower intensity.

tasks.title: Write core launch messaging and time-saved claims sheet and get client legal approval
acceptance_criteria: Draft messaging house and claims sheet submitted to client legal by 26 Oct, with source evidence for each time-saved claim
Every time-saved claim marked approved, amended or cut by client legal in writing
Approved version shared in #launch-ledgerly as the single source for Creative, Organic and Media
US English spelling throughout
tasks.assumption: Client legal can turn the review around within 5 working days (26 Oct to 2 Nov), raised as Q3. A longer turnaround would push every team that uses the claims.

tasks.title: Build and get client approval for the US small-business and fintech trade press target list
acceptance_criteria: List covers US small-business and fintech trade titles with named journalist, beat and contact for each
Each outlet tiered by priority with a note on embargo practice
Target list approved by the client in writing

tasks.title: Draft launch press release with spokesperson quote and submit to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Release uses only time-saved claims from the approved PR-1 claims sheet
Spokesperson quote drafted and approved by the spokesperson
Client marketing review done and release submitted to client legal by 9 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed the client names a spokesperson (likely CEO or Head of Product) by 2 Nov. If not, the quote and the briefings slip.

tasks.title: Finalize press release with client legal approval, ready for embargoed briefings
acceptance_criteria: Final release approved by the client and by client legal in writing
Spokesperson quote approved
Embargo lift time agreed with the client as 2 Dec at 9:00 ET and marked on the embargoed version
Final shared with Organic in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Client legal reviews the release within 5 working days of the 9 Nov submission. A longer review would compress the briefing window.

tasks.title: Pitch target press under embargo and book briefings for 16 to 23 Nov
acceptance_criteria: Embargoed pitch sent to every tier 1 and tier 2 contact on the approved list
Embargo terms (lift on 2 Dec) accepted in writing by each journalist before briefing
Briefings booked in the 16 to 23 Nov window, before it opens

tasks.title: Prepare the spokesperson for embargoed briefings
acceptance_criteria: Briefing pack delivered: key messages, approved claims only, Q&A on tricky questions, journalist bios
At least one mock briefing run with the spokesperson
Spokesperson confirms availability for all booked slots
tasks.assumption: Assumed a spokesperson is named by 2 Nov and available 16 to 23 Nov. If not named, prep and briefings move.

tasks.title: Run embargoed briefings and invite press to the 2 Dec launch webinar
acceptance_criteria: All booked briefings held between 16 and 23 Nov and logged with notes and follow-ups
Embargoed release and approved product stills sent to each briefed journalist, with the demo video offered for 2 Dec
Press invited to the launch webinar using the live registration page, with RSVPs tracked
tasks.assumption: Assumed the webinar time is confirmed and registration opens 16 Nov (Q5). If registration opens later, press invites follow it.

tasks.title: Distribute the press release on launch day as the embargo lifts
acceptance_criteria: Release distributed on 2 Dec at 9:00 ET, the lift time set in PR-2, to the approved list
Release live on the client newsroom with the webinar link and the CRE-9 press cut
Briefed journalists reminded that the embargo has lifted
tasks.assumption: Assumed a distribution method is agreed (direct to list or a wire service). A wire service needs budget, raised in Q4.

tasks.title: Track launch coverage and report results
acceptance_criteria: Coverage log of every piece with outlet, date, reach and claims accuracy
Any misquoted time-saved claim flagged to the client within 1 working day
Coverage report shared with the client and in #launch-ledgerly by 9 Dec

tasks.title: Develop and present three LinkedIn ad concepts and the demo video script and storyboard to Ledgerly
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct LinkedIn ad concepts aimed at US finance managers at companies with 20 to 200 staff, each shown as single image, carousel and video ad mockups
Demo video script and storyboard show receipt scanning filing expenses automatically, with product screen capture recorded so editing can start right after approval
Every time-saved claim used is taken word for word from the PR-1 legal-approved claims sheet
Concepts presented to the client and shared in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Team is at about 80% until 6 Nov, so concept work starts on kickoff with placeholder claims that are swapped for PR-1 wording on 2 to 4 Nov. If PR-1 slips, the presentation and CRE-1 slip with it.

tasks.title: Get client approval of the LinkedIn ad and demo video concepts
acceptance_criteria: Written client approval of three LinkedIn ad concepts and the demo video concept is recorded
One round of client feedback is folded in before approval
Approved concepts handed to Media with planned formats listed

tasks.title: Write webinar landing page wireframe and copy with SEO keywords and send copy to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Wireframe covers hero, webinar details for 2 Dec, demo video slot and registration form
Copy uses the primary and secondary keywords from ORG-1 in title, H1 and meta description
Time-saved claims match the PR-1 sheet and copy is sent to client legal by 3 Nov so approval lands by 9 Nov, 5 working days before the page goes live
US English spelling throughout

tasks.title: Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form and tracking, and pass mobile QA
acceptance_criteria: Page built with the legal-approved copy only, with client legal sign-off on file dated no later than 9 Nov
Registration form fields, UTM capture and tracking tags match the DAT-1 tracking plan and CRM lead fields, and a test submission reaches the webinar platform
Page passes mobile QA on iOS Safari and Android Chrome, plus desktop browsers (web page, no store badges)
Client approves the staging page

tasks.title: Publish the webinar landing page live with registration open
acceptance_criteria: Page is live on the production URL and a live test registration is received
Live copy matches the legal-approved version
URL shared with Organic, Data and Media in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Registration opens on 16 Nov, pending the human answer to Q5 on webinar time and early registration. If the time changes, only the webinar details block needs updating.

tasks.title: Cut the demo video rough cut and complete edit round 1
acceptance_criteria: Rough cut shared with the client on 10 Nov, built from the approved script and screen capture
Edit round 1 runs 11 to 13 Nov (3 working days) with client feedback logged
On-screen claims match the PR-1 sheet
tasks.assumption: Demo video is screen-recorded with motion graphics made in house, not a live-action shoot, so a rough cut can be ready one day after approval. A shoot would push CRE-3 past 23 Nov.

tasks.title: Complete demo video edit round 2, produce LinkedIn ads in all formats and send both to client legal
acceptance_criteria: Static and carousel ads for all three concepts sent to client legal on 13 Nov, ahead of the video package
Edit round 2 runs 16 to 18 Nov (3 working days) and the video is picture-locked with captions, then sent to client legal with the video ads on 18 Nov
Ads produced at 1200x1200 and 1200x628 for single image and carousel, 1:1 and 16:9 for video, with document ad as PDF
File names follow the DAT-1 naming convention

tasks.title: Deliver final legal-approved LinkedIn ad creative and demo video to Media
acceptance_criteria: Written client legal approval of every asset received by 23 Nov, 5 working days before the 2 Dec launch
Legal fixes made and files meet LinkedIn specs for size, length and file type
Assets handed to Media and Organic in a shared folder linked in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Client legal reviews assets within 2 working days (19 to 20 Nov), with fixes on 23 Nov. Q3 asks legal to confirm turnaround. A longer review would put the 23 Nov handoff at risk.

tasks.title: Deliver the demo video webinar cut and the press cut for launch day distribution
acceptance_criteria: Webinar cut in 16:9 delivered to the webinar owner by 24 Nov
Press cut with download link sent to PR by 24 Nov for the 2 Dec release, not for the embargoed briefings
Both cuts use only the legal-approved edit and claims
tasks.assumption: Webinar and press cuts are re-edits of the approved master, so they need no new legal review.

tasks.title: Deliver SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page copy to Creative
acceptance_criteria: Primary and secondary keywords for receipt scanning and expense automation listed with US search volume
Recommended page title, meta description, H1 and URL slug supplied
Shared with Creative in #launch-ledgerly by 26 Oct

tasks.title: Write keyword briefs for two SEO articles on expense automation
acceptance_criteria: Each article has one agreed target keyword, US market, US spelling
Briefs include outline, search intent, internal link to the webinar landing page and demo request CTA
Target keywords agreed with the client by 11 Nov

tasks.title: Draft both SEO articles and submit to client and legal review
acceptance_criteria: Two drafts written to their keyword briefs in US English
Time-saved claims used only as worded in the PR-1 approved claims sheet
All links tagged with Data's UTM convention from DAT-1
Drafts sent to client and legal by 16 Nov, 5 working days before the approval deadline

tasks.title: Secure client and legal approval of both SEO articles
acceptance_criteria: Written legal approval for both articles received by 23 Nov, 5 working days before the 2 Dec publish (Thanksgiving closures counted)
Feedback rounds applied and final versions logged
tasks.assumption: Assumed client legal can review in about 5 working days, which Q3 is confirming. A slower turnaround pushes publishing after launch.

tasks.title: Publish both SEO articles and link them from the webinar landing page
acceptance_criteria: Both approved articles live on launch day, each targeting its agreed keyword
Both articles linked from the webinar landing page and linking back to it
Every link carries the DAT-1 UTM tags and is checked in Data's QA

tasks.title: Write webinar email sequence copy and send schedule and submit to client and client legal
acceptance_criteria: Copy for invite, two reminders, day-of email and follow-up with recording and demo request CTA, in US English
Only time-saved claims from the PR-1 approved claims sheet, used verbatim
Sent to client and client legal by 3 Nov, with legal approval due by 9 Nov, 5 working days before the 16 Nov invite

tasks.title: Hand over approved invite and reminder emails for send from 16 Nov
acceptance_criteria: Client legal approval of the email copy on file, dated no later than 9 Nov
Invite links to the live CRE-2 registration page and every link carries DAT-1 UTMs
Approved copy and schedule handed to the confirmed sender on the confirmed platform
Test send checked for links, UTMs and rendering before the invite goes out
tasks.assumption: Assumed the client confirms sender and platform (Q2) before 16 Nov. If Organic must build in a client ESP or the webinar tool, setup time is needed and the invite may slip.

tasks.title: Send the follow-up email with webinar recording and demo request CTA on 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Follow-up sent on 3 Dec with the ORG-10 recording link
Demo request CTA points to the CRE-10 page and carries DAT-1 UTMs
Demo video from CRE-3 used only in its legal-approved form
tasks.assumption: Assumed sender (Q2) is confirmed and the recording is exported on 2 Dec in ORG-10.

tasks.title: Agree web and CRM tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields with client
acceptance_criteria: Tracking plan covers ad click, landing page view, webinar registration, sign-up and demo request, with no MMP or SKAN events, and is signed off by the client
UTM and campaign naming convention for LinkedIn and Google Search documented and shared with Media, Creative and Organic in #launch-ledgerly
CRM lead fields for company size (with a 20 to 200 staff band), source and campaign agreed with the client CRM owner
Draft circulated to the client by 29 Oct to leave review time before 9 Nov
tasks.assumption: Measurement playbook adapted for a web and CRM funnel: client product sign-off replaced by client marketing ops and CRM owner sign-off. If the client has no CRM owner available before 9 Nov, the date is at risk.

tasks.title: Configure CRM lead fields, UTM capture and lead source mapping in the client CRM
acceptance_criteria: Company size, source and campaign fields exist in the client CRM and match the DAT-1 spec
Hidden UTM fields spec for the registration, sign-up and demo request forms handed to Creative before the landing page goes live
Test lead created in the CRM sandbox shows all fields populated
tasks.assumption: Data gets admin or field-creation access to the client CRM by 9 Nov. If the client keeps CRM admin in-house, this becomes a spec handover and the client builds the fields.

tasks.title: Implement and QA tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click to CRM demo request
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads conversion tags and web analytics events fire on the live webinar landing page for registration
Test clicks with tagged UTMs from LinkedIn and Google create CRM leads with source, campaign and company size filled
QA log of test journeys shared in #launch-ledgerly, with all defects closed
Sign-up and demo request events on the post-webinar page are covered by DAT-8
tasks.assumption: CRE-2 lands on 16 Nov, leaving 5 working days for tagging and QA. A late landing page compresses QA directly.

tasks.title: QA Media's draft LinkedIn and Google Search tracking links before go-live
acceptance_criteria: Every draft ad's final URL and UTMs match the DAT-1 naming convention
One test click per campaign lands a correctly attributed lead in the CRM
Fix list sent to Media by 30 Nov, limited to tracking templates and UTM parameters so no ad re-enters platform review

tasks.title: Launch the live funnel dashboard on launch day
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows sign-ups against 2,500 in 45 days and demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies against 400
Spend and cost per lead shown by channel (LinkedIn, Google Search) and campaign, against the $90,000 paid media budget
Data refreshes at least daily and access is shared with the client and the team in #launch-ledgerly

tasks.title: Deliver the weekly pipeline report every Monday from 7 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Reports issued 7 Dec, 14 Dec, 21 Dec, 29 Dec (Tue, as 28 Dec is closed), 4 Jan, 11 Jan and 18 Jan
Each report covers sign-ups, demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies, spend and cost per lead against pace to target
Each report lists pipeline from CRM demo requests and one recommended action for Media

tasks.title: Deliver the campaign wrap report after day 45
acceptance_criteria: Measures every brief KPI: 2,500 sign-ups in 45 days and 400 demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies, from 2 Dec 2026 (day 1) to 15 Jan 2027 (day 45)
Reports spend and cost per lead by channel against the $90,000 budget
Includes learnings and recommendations, shared with the client

tasks.title: Build the post-webinar sign-up and demo request landing page for paid traffic from 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Page has a business sign-up form and a demo request form with a company size field matching the DAT-3 CRM spec
Copy reuses only legal-approved wording from CRE-2 and the PR-1 claims sheet, with legal sign-off on file by 24 Nov, 5 working days before 3 Dec use
Page is live on a production URL by 24 Nov so Media can submit ads to it for platform review
Page passes mobile QA on iOS Safari and Android Chrome and desktop browsers
tasks.assumption: Assumed Creative builds a new evergreen page because the webinar page stops serving the paid flight after 2 Dec (F1). If Ledgerly already has sign-up and demo request pages it owns, this becomes a URL and tracking handover and the question on destinations decides it.

tasks.title: Tag and QA sign-up and demo request events on the post-webinar landing page
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads conversions and web analytics fire for sign-up and demo request on the CRE-10 page
Test sign-up and test demo request with tagged UTMs create CRM leads with source, campaign and company size filled
QA log shared in #launch-ledgerly with all defects closed by 30 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed CRE-10 is live by 24 Nov. If the client owns the destination pages, Data QAs their forms instead.

tasks.title: Submit all launch ads and paused post-webinar ad variants for platform review
acceptance_criteria: Every LinkedIn and Google Search ad, pointing at the CRE-2 webinar page, submitted for platform review by 25 Nov
Duplicate ads pointing at the CRE-10 page submitted at the same time and left paused for the 3 Dec switch
Review status logged in #launch-ledgerly, with any rejection fixed and resubmitted by 30 Nov
tasks.assumption: Assumed later fixes are limited to tracking templates and UTM parameters, which do not restart platform review.

tasks.title: Switch paid traffic to the pre-approved post-webinar ads on 3 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Webinar-page ads paused and CRE-10 page ads switched on by 9:00 ET on 3 Dec
Test click per campaign lands on the CRE-10 page with correct UTMs
Switch confirmed in #launch-ledgerly
tasks.assumption: Assumed the post-webinar destination is the CRE-10 page and that ads with a replay offer are not wanted. The destination question decides this.

tasks.title: Pace the $90,000 and optimise from 17 Dec to day 45 on 15 Jan, covering closed days
acceptance_criteria: Daily caps and automated rules set before 24 Dec for 25 Dec, 28 Dec and 1 Jan, with a named on-call checker for each closed day
Cumulative spend stays within 5% of plan and total does not exceed $90,000 by 15 Jan
Weekly optimisation notes shared with Data for the pipeline report

tasks.title: Set up the 2 Dec webinar on the licensed platform with presenters, deck and run of show
acceptance_criteria: Webinar event created on the licensed platform with registration integration ready for the CRE-6 test by 12 Nov
Presenters named, deck outline using only PR-1 claims, and run of show agreed with the client
Recording enabled and a rehearsal date set before 2 Dec
tasks.assumption: No team's remit covers webinar production, so Organic is the provisional owner pending the webinar owner question. If the client runs the webinar, this becomes a handover task.

tasks.title: Run the 2 Dec launch webinar and export the recording
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal held by 1 Dec and webinar runs on the afternoon of 2 Dec with the CRE-9 webinar cut
Attendance and registration numbers shared with Data
Recording exported and link ready for the ORG-8 follow-up email the same day
tasks.assumption: Provisional Organic ownership, as for ORG-9. Client presenters are assumed.

tasks.title: Load and schedule the day-of webinar email for 2 Dec
acceptance_criteria: Day-of email built with confirmed webinar time and join link, legal-approved copy only
Test send checked for links, UTMs and rendering by 1 Dec
Send scheduled for the morning of 2 Dec to all registrants
tasks.assumption: Assumed sender and platform are confirmed (Q2) and the webinar time is set (Q5).

flags.question: Media's remit covers app UA (Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, Google App). Is Media staffed and approved to run LinkedIn and Google Search lead-gen campaigns for Ledgerly, or do we need extra support?
flags.why: L15 requires LinkedIn and Google Search live on 2 Dec. MED-1 drafts are due 25 Nov during busy Black Friday week.

flags.question: Who builds and sends the webinar registration email sequence, and on which platform (client ESP, CRM, or webinar tool)? No team's remit covers email sending.
flags.why: Organic is writing the sequence (L18), but sends must begin soon after the landing page goes live on 16 Nov, and Data needs to know the platform for tracking.

flags.question: Can client legal approve the messaging and time-saved claims sheet by 2 Nov, and confirm their turnaround time for reviewing assets after that?
flags.why: L22 requires a 5 working day lead. The landing page (16 Nov), press release (16 Nov) and final ads (23 Nov) all depend on PR-1 being approved by 2 Nov.

flags.question: Is the $90,000 for paid media only, and is there a separate budget for creative production (demo video) and press distribution? How should the $90,000 be split between LinkedIn and Google Search?
flags.why: L23 sets a budget for paid media only. The demo video and wire distribution costs, and the Media plan, depend on the answer.

flags.question: Please confirm the exact webinar time on 2 Dec and approve opening registration from 16 Nov, which is earlier than our standard landing page timing.
flags.why: L11 says only "that afternoon". The landing page, email sequence, press invites and campaign timing all depend on the time and when registration opens.

flags.question: Will Ledgerly provide LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads accounts with agency admin access and billing in place by 16 Nov, or should the agency create and bill these accounts?
flags.why: Media starts building draft campaigns from 16 Nov to hit MED-1 before Black Friday week. Without account access, billing and the LinkedIn Insight Tag, the drafts, tracking QA and 2 Dec go-live slip.

flags.question: Who is Ledgerly's spokesperson for the launch press release quote and the embargoed briefings, and can they be confirmed by 2 Nov and be free 16 to 23 Nov?
flags.why: The release quote (PR-4, legal by 9 Nov), spokesperson prep (PR-6) and the briefings (PR-7) all need a named, available spokesperson. A late name puts the 16 Nov legal-approved release (PR-2) at risk.

flags.question: Can the demo video be a screen-recorded product demo with in-house motion graphics, or does Ledgerly expect a live-action shoot?
flags.why: The plan assumes screen recording, so a rough cut is ready on 10 Nov and two 3-day edit rounds fit before the 23 Nov handoff (CRE-3). A live-action shoot needs booking and extra days and would miss 23 Nov.

flags.question: Which CRM does Ledgerly use, and will the client give Data admin access to create lead fields and test leads by 9 Nov? Also, should company size come from a form field or from enrichment?
flags.why: DAT-3 and DAT-2 need CRM access to build company size, source and campaign fields and to QA ad click to demo request tracking by 23 Nov. The 400 demo request KPI for 20 to 200 staff companies depends on how company size is captured.

flags.question: After the webinar ends on 2 Dec, where should paid ads send traffic for the rest of the 45 days, and who owns the sign-up and demo request pages: Ledgerly or our Creative team (CRE-10)?
flags.why: F1. The ads, tracking and follow-up email need a sign-up and demo request page from 3 Dec. CRE-10, DAT-8, MED-8 and MED-9 assume Creative builds a new page by 24 Nov.

flags.question: Who produces and runs the 2 Dec webinar (platform setup, presenters, deck, run of show, recording): Ledgerly or the agency? If it is the agency, is Organic the right owner?
flags.why: F2. No team's remit covers webinar production. ORG-9 and ORG-10 give it to Organic for now, and the follow-up email (ORG-8) and the CRE-6 registration test depend on it.

slack.text:
*Ledgerly receipts launch, kickoff*
We launch on *Wed 2 Dec 2026* in the US. Kickoff is today, 19 Oct.

*Critical dates*
• *PR:* claims sheet legal-approved 2 Nov, release final 16 Nov, embargoed briefings 16 to 23 Nov, distribution 2 Dec
• *Creative:* concepts approved 9 Nov, landing page live 16 Nov, final ads and video to Media 23 Nov
• *Media:* media plan 5 Nov, ad copy legal sign-off 20 Nov, draft builds 24 Nov, QA done 1 Dec, launch 2 Dec
• *Organic:* SEO input to Creative 26 Oct, emails handed over 16 Nov, articles approved 23 Nov, articles published 2 Dec
• *Data:* tracking plan agreed 9 Nov, CRM setup 13 Nov, tracking QA 23 Nov, link QA 30 Nov, dashboard live 2 Dec, weekly reports from 7 Dec

*Open questions*
• *Q1* Is Media staffed for LinkedIn and Google Search lead gen?
• *Q2* Who sends the webinar emails, and on which platform?
• *Q3* Can legal approve claims by 2 Nov, and what is their review turnaround?
• *Q4* What does the $90,000 cover, and how is it split between LinkedIn and Google?
• *Q5* What time is the webinar, and can registration open 16 Nov?
• *Q6* Will ad account access and billing be ready by 16 Nov?
• *Q7* Who is the spokesperson, and can they be confirmed by 2 Nov?
• *Q8* Screen-recorded demo or live-action shoot?
• *Q9* Which CRM, admin access by 9 Nov, and where company size comes from

input.question: Can client legal review these in parallel and sign off by the dates shown: emails by 9 Nov, ad text by 20 Nov, and the release, creative, articles and post-webinar page all by 23 to 24 Nov?
input.why: F5. Six legal reviews fall between 9 and 24 Nov, and CRE-3 assumes only a 2 day review of the video package. If one review is slow, that asset breaks the 5 working day rule for 2 Dec. We moved the static ads up to 13 Nov to spread the load.

name: flag_for_human
text:
Flagged Q12 for the human approver. Do not wait for an answer; keep planning.
[step 8 of 14]

milestones.title: SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page copy
Core launch messaging and time-saved claims sheet approved by client legal
Tracking plan, UTM and naming convention, CRM lead fields agreed
LinkedIn ad and demo video concepts approved by client
Webinar landing page live with registration form, legal-approved copy
Press release final and approved by client legal, ready for embargoed briefings
Final legal-approved LinkedIn ad creative and demo video delivered to Media
Ad click to CRM demo request tracking live and QA'd
LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns built in draft with tracking links for QA

assignments.scope: Plan and run LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns aimed at US finance managers at small businesses, live on launch day 2 Dec 2026, within the $90,000 paid media budget. Deliver a media plan with budget split by platform for client approval, audiences (LinkedIn targeting on company size 20 to 200 for demo goal), keyword plan for Search, and campaigns built in draft with Data's naming convention and tracking links by 25 Nov (MED-1). Go live 2 Dec and pace budget daily for the first two weeks, optimising to sign-ups and demo requests. Note: these platforms sit outside the usual app UA remit, and Black Friday week is busy, so build drafts early. Team is free from 2 Nov. Any time-saved claim in ad copy must come from the legal-approved claims sheet (PR-1).

Own core launch messaging and the time-saved claims sheet, and get it approved by client legal by 2 Nov (PR-1) so every team uses the same approved claims. Write the launch press release with spokesperson quote, final and legal-approved by 16 Nov (PR-2). Build a target list of small-business and fintech trade press, pitch under embargo, run briefings between 16 Nov and 23 Nov, prep the spokesperson, and distribute the release on launch day 2 Dec with the embargo lifting that day. Invite press to the launch webinar. Track coverage after launch.

Produce three LinkedIn ad concepts and the product demo video concept, approved by the client by 9 Nov (CRE-1). Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form, SEO input from Organic and Data's tracking, with copy legal-approved and page live by 16 Nov (CRE-2) so registration can open. The page is web, not app, so ignore store badge criteria; it must pass mobile QA. Produce final LinkedIn ad creative in all LinkedIn formats and the demo video, legal-reviewed and delivered to Media by 23 Nov (CRE-3). Each video edit round needs 3 working days and capacity is about 80% until 6 Nov, so plan edit rounds early. Supply a cut of the demo video for the webinar and press.

Provide SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page by 26 Oct (ORG-1). Write two SEO articles on expense automation: keyword briefs by 11 Nov, drafts to client and legal so approval lands at least 5 working days before publishing, publish on or just after launch and link from the landing page. Write the webinar registration email sequence (invite, reminders, day-of, follow-up with recording and demo request CTA), using legal-approved claims only, starting once the landing page is live on 16 Nov. Who sends the emails and on which platform is still open with the client; plan copy and schedule either way. Use Data's UTM convention on every link.

This is a web and CRM funnel, not an app, so adapt the measurement playbook: no MMP or SKAN. Agree the tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields (company size, source, campaign) by 9 Nov (DAT-1). Implement tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click through landing page and webinar registration to sign-up and demo request in the client CRM, live and QA'd by 23 Nov (DAT-2). QA Media's draft tracking links from 25 Nov (MED-1) before go-live. Dashboard live on launch day 2 Dec tracking sign-ups (target 2,500 in 45 days), demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies (target 400), spend and cost per lead. flags.question: Media's remit covers app UA (Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, Google App). Is Media staffed and approved to run LinkedIn and Google Search lead-gen campaigns for Ledgerly, or do we need extra support?
flags.why: L15 requires LinkedIn and Google Search live on 2 Dec. MED-1 drafts are due 25 Nov during busy Black Friday week.

flags.question: Who builds and sends the webinar registration email sequence, and on which platform (client ESP, CRM, or webinar tool)? No team's remit covers email sending.
flags.why: Organic is writing the sequence (L18), but sends must begin soon after the landing page goes live on 16 Nov, and Data needs to know the platform for tracking.

flags.question: Can client legal approve the messaging and time-saved claims sheet by 2 Nov, and confirm their turnaround time for reviewing assets after that?
flags.why: L22 requires a 5 working day lead. The landing page (16 Nov), press release (16 Nov) and final ads (23 Nov) all depend on PR-1 being approved by 2 Nov.

flags.question: Is the $90,000 for paid media only, and is there a separate budget for creative production (demo video) and press distribution? How should the $90,000 be split between LinkedIn and Google Search?
flags.why: L23 sets a budget for paid media only. The demo video and wire distribution costs, and the Media plan, depend on the answer.

flags.question: Please confirm the exact webinar time on 2 Dec and approve opening registration from 16 Nov, which is earlier than our standard landing page timing.
flags.why: L11 says only "that afternoon". The landing page, email sequence, press invites and campaign timing all depend on the time and when registration opens.

flags.question: Will Ledgerly provide LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads accounts with agency admin access and billing in place by 16 Nov, or should the agency create and bill these accounts?
flags.why: Media starts building draft campaigns from 16 Nov to hit MED-1 before Black Friday week. Without account access, billing and the LinkedIn Insight Tag, the drafts, tracking QA and 2 Dec go-live slip.

flags.question: Who is Ledgerly's spokesperson for the launch press release quote and the embargoed briefings, and can they be confirmed by 2 Nov and be free 16 to 23 Nov?
flags.why: The release quote (PR-4, legal by 9 Nov), spokesperson prep (PR-6) and the briefings (PR-7) all need a named, available spokesperson. A late name puts the 16 Nov legal-approved release (PR-2) at risk.

flags.question: Can the demo video be a screen-recorded product demo with in-house motion graphics, or does Ledgerly expect a live-action shoot?
flags.why: The plan assumes screen recording, so a rough cut is ready on 10 Nov and two 3-day edit rounds fit before the 23 Nov handoff (CRE-3). A live-action shoot needs booking and extra days and would miss 23 Nov.

flags.question: Which CRM does Ledgerly use, and will the client give Data admin access to create lead fields and test leads by 9 Nov? Also, should company size come from a form field or from enrichment?
flags.why: DAT-3 and DAT-2 need CRM access to build company size, source and campaign fields and to QA ad click to demo request tracking by 23 Nov. The 400 demo request KPI for 20 to 200 staff companies depends on how company size is captured.

flags.question: After the webinar ends on 2 Dec, where should paid ads send traffic for the rest of the 45 days, and who owns the sign-up and demo request pages: Ledgerly or our Creative team (CRE-10)?
flags.why: F1. The ads, tracking and follow-up email need a sign-up and demo request page from 3 Dec. CRE-10, DAT-8, MED-8 and MED-9 assume Creative builds a new page by 24 Nov.

flags.question: Who produces and runs the 2 Dec webinar (platform setup, presenters, deck, run of show, recording): Ledgerly or the agency? If it is the agency, is Organic the right owner?
flags.why: F2. No team's remit covers webinar production. ORG-9 and ORG-10 give it to Organic for now, and the follow-up email (ORG-8) and the CRE-6 registration test depend on it.

flags.question: Can client legal review these in parallel and sign off by the dates shown: emails by 9 Nov, ad text by 20 Nov, and the release, creative, articles and post-webinar page all by 23 to 24 Nov?
flags.why: F5. Six legal reviews fall between 9 and 24 Nov, and CRE-3 assumes only a 2 day review of the video package. If one review is slow, that asset breaks the 5 working day rule for 2 Dec. We moved the static ads up to 13 Nov to spread the load.

assignments.scope: Plan and run LinkedIn and Google Search campaigns aimed at US finance managers at small businesses, live on launch day 2 Dec 2026, within the $90,000 paid media budget. Deliver a media plan with budget split by platform for client approval, audiences (LinkedIn targeting on company size 20 to 200 for demo goal), keyword plan for Search, and campaigns built in draft with Data's naming convention and tracking links by 25 Nov (MED-1). Go live 2 Dec and pace budget daily for the first two weeks, optimising to sign-ups and demo requests. Note: these platforms sit outside the usual app UA remit, and Black Friday week is busy, so build drafts early. Team is free from 2 Nov. Any time-saved claim in ad copy must come from the legal-approved claims sheet (PR-1).

Own core launch messaging and the time-saved claims sheet, and get it approved by client legal by 2 Nov (PR-1) so every team uses the same approved claims. Write the launch press release with spokesperson quote, final and legal-approved by 16 Nov (PR-2). Build a target list of small-business and fintech trade press, pitch under embargo, run briefings between 16 Nov and 23 Nov, prep the spokesperson, and distribute the release on launch day 2 Dec with the embargo lifting that day. Invite press to the launch webinar. Track coverage after launch.

Produce three LinkedIn ad concepts and the product demo video concept, approved by the client by 9 Nov (CRE-1). Design and build the webinar landing page with registration form, SEO input from Organic and Data's tracking, with copy legal-approved and page live by 16 Nov (CRE-2) so registration can open. The page is web, not app, so ignore store badge criteria; it must pass mobile QA. Produce final LinkedIn ad creative in all LinkedIn formats and the demo video, legal-reviewed and delivered to Media by 23 Nov (CRE-3). Each video edit round needs 3 working days and capacity is about 80% until 6 Nov, so plan edit rounds early. Supply a cut of the demo video for the webinar and press.

Provide SEO keyword input for the webinar landing page by 26 Oct (ORG-1). Write two SEO articles on expense automation: keyword briefs by 11 Nov, drafts to client and legal so approval lands at least 5 working days before publishing, publish on or just after launch and link from the landing page. Write the webinar registration email sequence (invite, reminders, day-of, follow-up with recording and demo request CTA), using legal-approved claims only, starting once the landing page is live on 16 Nov. Who sends the emails and on which platform is still open with the client; plan copy and schedule either way. Use Data's UTM convention on every link.

This is a web and CRM funnel, not an app, so adapt the measurement playbook: no MMP or SKAN. Agree the tracking plan, UTM and naming convention and CRM lead fields (company size, source, campaign) by 9 Nov (DAT-1). Implement tracking from LinkedIn and Google ad click through landing page and webinar registration to sign-up and demo request in the client CRM, live and QA'd by 23 Nov (DAT-2). QA Media's draft tracking links from 25 Nov (MED-1) before go-live. Dashboard live on launch day 2 Dec tracking sign-ups (target 2,500 in 45 days), demo requests from 20 to 200 staff companies (target 400), spend and cost per lead. Weekly pipeline report every Monday from 7 Dec and a wrap report after day 45 (16 Jan 2027).

flags.question: Who builds and sends the webinar registration email sequence, and on which platform (client ESP, CRM, or webinar tool)? No team's remit covers email sending.
